title: Review-2: consolidate CredentialStore convergence check
notes:
NOT CONVERGED: 1 P2 finding filed (stoa-ff000988.1: from_content uses parse_bcrypt_cost without length check while config validation uses looks_like_bcrypt_hash — inconsistency allows short-but-prefixed hashes to slip into the credential store via credential_file path, failing silently at auth time rather than at load time).
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — the codebase follows most Rust conventions well. The three P1 findings are mechanical fixes (thiserror, PathBuf, unwrap comment). No unsafe, no Box<dyn Error> in library APIs, no gratuitous clones, iterators are idiomatic throughout. The ConfigError manual impl is the most impactful gap.
Rust idiom confidence: 85% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: sp5s.3 (PathBuf migration may interact with secretx: URI handling which expects String). Uncertainty driven by: lifecycle.rs was read in chunks (too large for single read) — the POST pipeline tail (lines ~1100 onward) and helper functions were not reviewed; any idiom issues there were not seen.
